headline: Discussion of Complete Streets and Vision Zero, with updates on several local projects and groups.
summary: Updates cover the Wild Seed Demonstration Garden, the first meeting of the Beach Management Ad Hoc Committee on November 10, 2026, and a follow-up on a UNE summer fellow. The agenda also includes approving minutes from November 2, 2026.
